description: Sectional in-page navigation with an optional scroll-spy that tracks the active section as the user scrolls. Renders a minimal, generic item list (id + label); hosts that need badges, status dots, or required markers supply an ItemTemplate. Clicking an item always smooth-scrolls to the matching element id; EnableScrollSpy additionally keeps the active item in sync while scrolling.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: Sections to list. Only items with IsVisible == true render, ordered by Order.

parameters.name: ItemTemplate
parameters.description: Optional per-item render override. Falls back to the item's Label when null.

parameters.name: ActiveId
parameters.description: Active section id. Supports @bind-ActiveId; also updated by scroll-spy when enabled.

parameters.name: ActiveIdChanged
parameters.description: Fires whenever the active section changes, whether by click or scroll-spy.

parameters.name: OnNavigate
parameters.description: Raised when a section is explicitly selected by click (not by scroll-spy).

parameters.name: EnableScrollSpy
parameters.description: When true, observes section elements by id and tracks the active one on scroll via a passive scroll listener.

parameters.name: ScrollOffset
parameters.description: Distance from the top (px) at which a section becomes active during scroll-spy.

parameters.name: ScrollContainerSelector
parameters.description: CSS selector of the element that actually scrolls the sections. Null (the default) listens on the window, which is correct only when the page itself scrolls; an application shell that puts the content in its own overflow-y: auto column never raises a window scroll event, so scroll-spy silently never fires. Point this at that column and ScrollOffset is then measured from the top of the container rather than from the top of the viewport.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: Layout variant: SideRail (vertical, sticky) or Breadcrumb (horizontal strip).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Optional rail heading. Rendered only in the SideRail variant.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

examples.title: Side-rail scroll-spy navigation
examples.code:
<TmScrollSpyNav Items="@_sections" @bind-ActiveId="_activeSection" EnableScrollSpy="true" Title="On this page" />

@code {
    private string? _activeSection;
    private readonly IReadOnlyList<ScrollSpyNavItem> _sections =
    [
        new("overview", "Overview", Order: 0),
        new("pricing", "Pricing", Order: 1),
        new("faq", "FAQ", Order: 2),
    ];
}
